drc.prefix: The Council extended the Group of Experts mandate to 1 August 2024, intending to review and act on a possible further extension by 1 July 2024. It requested a midterm report to the Council by 30 December 2023 and a final report by 15 June 2024. The Group shall send monthly updates to the Council.
drc.sentences: The Council extended the Group of Experts mandate to 1 August 2024, intending to review and potentially further extend it by 1 July 2024. It requested a midterm report to the Council, following Committee discussion, by 30 December 2023, and a final report by 15 June 2024.
drc.independent: On 27 June 2023, the Council unanimously extended the Group of Experts mandate to 1 August 2024. A review is scheduled for 1 July 2024. The Council requested a midterm report by 30 December 2023 and a final report by 15 June 2024. The Group shall submit monthly updates to the Committee, excluding months when reports are due.
drc.interactive: On 27 June 2023, the Council unanimously adopted resolution 2688 (2023), extending the Group of Experts mandate to 1 August 2024. The Group must submit a report for review by 1 July 2024. This update applies to the responsible institution and recipient as per the mandate's review requirements.

unami.prefix: The Council extended the UNAMI mandate until 31 May 2024. The Secretary-General was requested to report on UNAMI fulfilment every four months and to conduct an independent strategic review by 31 March 2024, consulting Iraq, UN agencies, Member States, and regional organizations.
unami.sentences: The Council extended the UNAMI mandate until 31 May 2024. The Secretary-General was requested to report on UNAMI fulfilment every four months and to provide an independent strategic review by 31 March 2024. These requirements apply to the Council. The vote on resolution 2682 (2023) was 15 in favour.
unami.independent: On 30 May 2023, the Council voted 15–0 to adopt Resolution 2682 (2023), extending UNAMI's mandate to 31 May 2024. The Secretary-General is to conduct an independent strategic review by 31 March 2024, consulting Iraq, UN agencies, Member States, regional organizations, experts, and civil society. Iraq's Government supported the resolution.
unami.interactive: On 30 May 2023, the Council voted 15–0 to adopt Resolution 2682 (2023), extending UNAMI's mandate to 31 May 2024. The President announced adoption and the meeting ended. The Chair is to report on the resolution's review. The Secretary-General must conduct an independent strategic review of UNAMI by 31 March 2024, consulting Iraq, UN agencies, and Member States.
